tutorial.contract: Each round has a fixed contract of melds you must lay down before you can go out. Watch the contract banner at the top.
tutorial.hand: Pick cards from your hand and add them to slots that match the contract. A card can only fill one slot. Jokers are wild.
tutorial.actions: Each turn: draw a card → meet the contract / lay melds / lay off → discard one card to end your turn.

frontendHint.cariocaTakeDiscard: That card is material for your hand — take it
frontendHint.cariocaDrawStock: The discard is no help — draw from the stock
frontendHint.cariocaMeetContract: The contract goes down whole — hold your cards until the sets and runs are there
frontendHint.cariocaMeetSets: The contract goes down whole — hold your cards until the three-of-a-kind sets are there
frontendHint.cariocaDiscardCostly: Discard the card that connects with nothing and costs the most if it stays
